en.headline: Chief Executive concludes advisers' talks on first five-year plan
en.dek: John Lee held three days of working luncheons with the Chief Executive's Council of Advisers to gather views on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday concluded three consecutive days of working luncheons with members of the Chief Executive's Council of Advisers, running from Tuesday to today, to collect insights on the formulation of Hong Kong's first five-year plan, the 2026 Policy Address and the city's overall development.

Mr Lee said he is leading the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government in drafting the first five-year plan. He noted that the plan and the annual Policy Address are closely aligned, with the Policy Address serving as the yearly report on the plan's implementation.

Discussions focused on three core pillars as Hong Kong aligns with the national 15th Five-Year Plan. The first covers economic advancement and sustainability, including strengthening Hong Kong's position as an international centre for finance, shipping and trade and accelerating the Northern Metropolis as a growth engine. The second targets innovation and entrepreneurship to modernise traditional industries and develop Hong Kong into an international innovation and technology centre. The third emphasises deeper Greater Bay Area integration, Belt and Road participation and expanded international cooperation.

The luncheons were chaired by the Chief Executive together with senior officials including Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki, Secretary for Justice Paul Lam, Acting Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Janice Tse, Director of the Chief Executive's Office Carol Yip and Head of the Chief Executive's Policy Unit Stephen Wong.

zh.headline: 李家超與特首顧問團完成三年規劃及施政報告交流
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超一連三日與特首顧問團舉行工作午餐，聽取對香港第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告的意見。
body: 行政長官李家超星期四結束與特首顧問團一連三日（星期二至今日）的工作午餐，聽取顧問團成員對香港第一個五年規劃、2026年施政報告及整體發展的意見。
李家超表示，他正領導特區政府制訂香港第一個五年規劃。他指出，五年規劃與施政報告緊密配合，施政報告是五年規劃的年度落實報告。
討論圍繞三大支柱展開，以配合國家「十五五」規劃。第一支柱聚焦經濟提升與可持續發展，包括鞏固香港國際金融、航運及貿易中心地位，以及加快北部都會區成為新質生產力增長引擎。第二支柱針對創新創業，現代化傳統產業並將香港發展為國際創科中心。第三支柱強調深化粵港澳大灣區融合、參與高質量一帶一路發展及擴大國際交流合作。
工作午餐由行政長官主持，出席的高級官員包括政務司司長陳國基、律政司司長林定國、署理財政司司長黃偉綸、政制及內地事務局局長謝小華、行政長官辦公室主任葉文娟及行政長官政策組組長黃元山。
